pr_title: user - set current expiration correctly when no shadow entry exists
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY
If no entry for a user account exists in `/etc/shadow` an empty string is returned for the expiration value. Trying to convert that to an `int` raises a `ValueError`.

Ensure the value for expiration is set to `0` if unable to read the shadow file.

Fixes #71916.

##### ISSUE TYPE
<!--- Pick one below and delete the rest -->
- Bugfix Pull Request


##### COMPONENT NAME
<!--- Write the short name of the module, plugin, task or feature below -->
`lib/ansible/modules/user.py`
